title: Charges before trial is over

I really do love the app and hopefully in the near future, I will be able to afford the subscription so I am able to support the developer. I am updating my review from 1 to 5 stars based on the interaction with the developer and the developer showing that they truly are a Christian disciple by the way they interact when there is a problem. If you are able to afford the subscription, please support them because it is an excellent app with singing the scriptures. I signed up for the trial and cancelled two days after signing up. They are still trying to charge me and I emailed the company and no response. title: weekly expense
body: My husband got it on his phone. We could only hear it from his phone it can’t be shared. I couldn’t wait for him to get home from work to hear it. It’s wonderful to hear but costly. We thought it was $9.99 per month and it’s not it’s weekly. If you can afford to pay each week then it’s a good investment. Some people are not able to pay $9.99. My husband is always busy working and can’t hear it as much as he’d like to. He cannot use his phone at work only on his break. It’s not very much time. If you have unlimited time to hear it then that’s great. If perhaps you’re a business owner you can have it all day at your business singing scripture. The app itself is 5 stars.
